name: X (Twitter) Connector
label: X / Twitter Connector (API v2)
description: Stateless X (Twitter) API v2 client for StudioQuack workflows. Speaks https://api.x.com/2 with either an App-only Bearer Token (public reads: user lookup, mentions, recent search) or a User Access Token from OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with PKCE (required for DM read/write, post_tweet, and reply_tweet). New apps use pay-per-usage credits (no Free/Basic/Pro for new signups as of 2026-02; https://developer.x.com/#pricing). Default action is 'stats'. EXACT mode values: 'sandbox' (canned stubs, no HTTP; default) or 'live' (real HTTPS to api.x.com). Tokens are read ONLY from configurationParameters (password fields). Do not put tokens on edges. input.mode may override sandbox|live. Reusable — attach via a FUNCTION port to any orchestrator that needs X read/write. Example: action='get_user', handle='studioquack', mode='sandbox' returns status='ok' with a stub user id 9999999. Use is subject to the X Developer Agreement and Policy: https://developer.x.com/en/developer-terms/agreement-and-policy.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One X Connector request object delivered as inputVariables.input (or currentNode.inputList targetPortValue=input). Purpose: select the action and supply that action's fields (handle, query, body, ids). EXACT action values: 'get_user', 'list_mentions', 'list_dm_events', 'send_dm', 'search_tweets', 'search_recent' (alias of search_tweets), 'reply_tweet', 'reply' (alias of reply_tweet), 'post_tweet', 'stats'. Omitted/blank action defaults to 'stats'. EXACT mode override values: 'sandbox' | 'live' (any other non-blank string is treated as not-live / sandbox stubs). Do not put tokens on this port. Example: {"action":"get_user","handle":"studioquack"}.

schema.label: Action
schema.description: Purpose: selects which X API v2 operation to run. Compared case-insensitively after trim; the echoed output.action is this requested alias (search_recent stays search_recent). EXACT accepted values: 'get_user' (GET /2/users/by/username/{handle}; requires handle), 'list_mentions' (GET /2/users/{id}/mentions; requires user_id or default_user_id), 'list_dm_events' (GET /2/dm_conversations/{id}/dm_events or GET /2/dm_events; live requires user_access_token with dm.read), 'send_dm' (POST /2/dm_conversations/with/{recipient_id}/messages; requires recipient_id + body; live requires user_access_token with dm.write), 'search_tweets' (GET /2/tweets/search/recent; requires query), 'search_recent' (alias of search_tweets), 'reply_tweet' (POST /2/tweets with reply.in_reply_to_tweet_id; requires body + in_reply_to_tweet_id|tweet_id|parent_id; live requires user_access_token with tweet.write), 'reply' (alias of reply_tweet), 'post_tweet' (POST /2/tweets; requires body; live requires user_access_token with tweet.write), 'stats' (local capability snapshot; no HTTP). Unknown values return {"error":"Unknown action '{a}'. Valid: ['get_user', 'list_dm_events', 'list_mentions', 'post_tweet', 'reply', 'reply_tweet', 'search_recent', 'search_tweets', 'send_dm', 'stats']"} with aliases included. Default when omitted/blank: 'stats'. Example: 'get_user'.

schema.label: Mode Override
schema.description: Purpose: per-call override of configurationParameters.mode. Compared case-insensitively after trim. EXACT accepted values: 'sandbox' (canned stubs, never calls X), 'live' (HTTPS to https://api.x.com/2; requires bearer_token or user_access_token on configuration except for action='stats'). Blank/omitted keeps the instance config (default 'sandbox'). Any other non-blank string is treated as not-live (sandbox stubs), matching Python `mode != 'live'`. Example: 'sandbox'.

schema.label: Handle
schema.description: Purpose: X username path segment for action='get_user' (GET /2/users/by/username/{handle}). The handler URL-encodes this segment. Required for get_user in sandbox and live; missing/blank fails with Error: ValueError: handle required for get_user. Accepted values: handle without a leading '@' (letters, digits, underscore; encoding allows other UTF-8). Leading '@' is sent as-is if supplied. Example: 'studioquack'.

schema.label: User ID
schema.description: Purpose: numeric X user id for action='list_mentions' (GET /2/users/{id}/mentions). Required unless configurationParameters.default_user_id is set; missing both fails with Error: ValueError: user_id required (or default_user_id config). Accepted values: X snowflake id as a decimal string. Blank falls through to default_user_id. Example: '44196397'.

schema.label: Conversation ID
schema.description: Purpose: DM conversation id for action='list_dm_events'. When set in live mode the handler GET /2/dm_conversations/{id}/dm_events; when blank it GET /2/dm_events (all conversations). Sandbox does NOT require this field (result.conversation_id becomes the supplied id or 'sandbox-conv'). Accepted values: X conversation snowflake as a decimal string, or blank. Example: '1234567890'.

schema.label: Recipient ID
schema.description: Purpose: numeric X user id of the DM recipient for action='send_dm' (POST /2/dm_conversations/with/{recipient_id}/messages). Required together with body; missing either fails with Error: ValueError: recipient_id and body required for send_dm. Accepted values: X user snowflake as a decimal string. Example: '1234567'.

schema.label: In Reply To Tweet ID
schema.description: Purpose: parent post id for action='reply_tweet' or alias 'reply'. The handler also accepts input.tweet_id or input.parent_id as fallbacks (first non-blank of in_reply_to_tweet_id, tweet_id, parent_id). Required together with body; missing either fails with Error: ValueError: body and in_reply_to_tweet_id (or tweet_id/parent_id) required for reply_tweet. Live POST /2/tweets sends {"text":body,"reply":{"in_reply_to_tweet_id":parent}}. Accepted values: tweet/post snowflake as a decimal string. Example: '1770000000000000000'.

schema.label: Body
schema.description: Purpose: message or post text. Required for 'send_dm' (DM text), 'post_tweet' (new post), and 'reply_tweet'/'reply' (reply text). Missing/blank fails with the matching ValueError for that action. Leading/trailing whitespace is preserved. Accepted values: UTF-8 string. X enforces account/product limits (typically 280 characters for standard posts; DMs have separate policy limits) — the handler does not truncate. Example: 'Hello from StudioQuack'.

schema.label: Query
schema.description: Purpose: recent-search query for action='search_tweets' or alias 'search_recent' (GET /2/tweets/search/recent). Required; missing/blank fails with Error: ValueError: query required for search_tweets. Official recent search covers about the last 7 days unless the X product tier includes full-archive. Accepted values: X query syntax (operators such as from:, to:, lang:, has:, -is:retweet, @handle, #hashtag). Example: '@studioquack -is:retweet lang:en'.

schema.label: Since
schema.description: Purpose: ISO 8601 lower bound mapped to X query param start_time for action='list_mentions' in live mode. Ignored in sandbox and for other actions. Blank/omitted omits start_time. Accepted values: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamps X accepts (e.g. YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Example: '2026-08-01T00:00:00Z'.

schema.label: Limit
schema.description: Purpose: row cap for list/search actions. Default when omitted/non-numeric: 25. Sandbox list_mentions returns min(limit, 3) stub tweets. Live list_mentions sends max_results=min(max(limit,5),100). Live search_tweets/search_recent sends max_results=min(max(limit,10),100). Live list_dm_events sends max_results=limit with no extra clamp (X may reject out-of-range). Accepted values: integers. Example: 25.

schema.label: pagination_token
schema.description: pagination_token for mentions/search paging (X API next_token). Example: from prior meta.next_token.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Single response object (this is the only reply key). Success: {status:'ok', action:<requested alias>, result:<action payload>}. Tokens never appear in this object; stats.result may include has_bearer/has_user_token booleans only. Example success: {"status":"ok","action":"stats","result":{"mode":"sandbox","base_url":"sandbox://x","has_bearer":false,"has_user_token":false,"default_user_id":null}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Purpose: success marker on the output object. Present only on success. EXACT accepted value: 'ok'. Absent when output.error is set. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Action
schema.description: Purpose: echo of the requested action alias (not the canonical handler name). Present only on success. EXACT accepted values: 'get_user', 'list_mentions', 'list_dm_events', 'send_dm', 'search_tweets', 'search_recent', 'reply_tweet', 'reply', 'post_tweet', 'stats'. Example: 'search_recent'.

schema.label: Result
schema.description: Purpose: action-specific payload. Sandbox: canned objects with mode='sandbox' (see node README). Live: raw X API v2 JSON (user object, tweet list, DM events, create response). stats: {mode, base_url ('https://api.x.com/2' when live else 'sandbox://x'), has_bearer, has_user_token, default_user_id or null}. Never contains token strings. Example (sandbox get_user): {"mode":"sandbox","data":{"id":"9999999","username":"studioquack","name":"Sandbox User"}}.

configurationParameters.label: Mode
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: instance default for whether the handler calls X. input.mode overrides this per call when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'sandbox' (default — canned stubs, no HTTP to api.x.com), 'live' (real HTTPS to https://api.x.com/2; requires configuration bearer_token or user_access_token except when action='stats'). Compared case-insensitively. Any other non-blank value is treated as not-live (sandbox stubs). Example: 'sandbox'.

configurationParameters.label: Bearer Token (App-only)
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: App-only Bearer Token sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' for public reads (get_user, list_mentions, search_tweets). Cannot authorize DMs or write actions. Bind a StudioQuack secret; never paste a production token into the committed JSON and never put this value on an INPUT edge (input.bearer_token is ignored). Accepted values: X Bearer token string, or blank (sandbox; live non-stats requires this or user_access_token). To obtain: (1) Sign up at https://console.x.com and create a Project + App. (2) App → Keys and Tokens → Generate Bearer Token and copy it once. Pay-per-usage applies on X v2. Example: leave '' in sandbox; in live bind $secretRef to the Bearer.

configurationParameters.label: User Access Token (OAuth 2.0 PKCE)
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: User Access Token from OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with PKCE. Required in live mode for list_dm_events, send_dm, post_tweet, and reply_tweet. Also usable for public reads. Bind a StudioQuack secret; never put this on an INPUT edge (input.user_access_token is ignored). Accepted values: OAuth 2 access_token string, or blank. Required X scopes: tweet.read users.read dm.read dm.write tweet.write offline.access. To obtain: (1) console.x.com App → User authentication settings → enable OAuth 2.0, permissions 'Read and write and Direct message', set callback + website URL. (2) Note Client ID (and Client Secret if confidential). (3) PKCE code_verifier (43–128 URL-safe chars) and SHA-256 code_challenge. (4) Authorize at https://x.com/i/oauth2/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=CLIENT_ID&redirect_uri=REDIRECT&scope=tweet.read%20users.read%20dm.read%20dm.write%20tweet.write%20offline.access&state=STATE&code_challenge=CHALLENGE&code_challenge_method=S256. (5) POST https://api.x.com/2/oauth2/token grant_type=authorization_code with code, redirect_uri, code_verifier, client_id. Refresh with grant_type=refresh_token. Example: leave '' in sandbox; in live bind $secretRef to the access_token.

configurationParameters.label: Pagination Token
configurationParameters.description: Default pagination_token for mentions/search paging when INPUT omits it.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: per-call HTTP connect/read timeout for live requests to https://api.x.com/2 (unused in sandbox). Accepted values: positive integers (seconds). Default: 25. Omitted, non-numeric, or ≤0 falls back to 25. The handler does not clamp an upper bound; keep this within the daemon/job budget. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Default User ID
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: fallback X user id for action='list_mentions' when input.user_id is blank. stats.result.default_user_id echoes this value or null when blank. Accepted values: X user snowflake as a decimal string, or blank (no fallback; list_mentions then requires input.user_id). Find the id once via get_user with your handle. Example: '44196397'.
